entries.0aa5c72d6f806ec7: This is a single segment of the group, consisting of the company and one consolidated subsidiary, and is made up of two parts: a matching platform centered on the housing-sector vertical media 'Livin Match,' and a DX cloud that supports operational efficiency at housing-related companies. Operating revenue for the fiscal year ended September 2025 was ¥3,592 million.
entries.3c2d9a68064a7653: This is a business that provides, via the cloud, Web services (SaaS) and other services that promote operational efficiency at housing-related companies.
entries.43d63a2f2d8366ff: Through services such as "Livingmatch" and "Nurimatch," this business matches end users who want to sell or make use of real estate with client companies such as real estate companies on the Web. Fees are either a per-inquiry charge or a fixed charge, and end users can make inquiries to multiple companies at once free of charge. Revenue for the fiscal year ended September 2025 was ¥3,163 million.
entries.7b6496d1d262dc23: This is a business that matches, on the Web, end users who want to sell or make use of real estate with client companies such as real estate companies, through services such as "Livin Match" and "Nuri Match."
entries.a87bca03c30eb87e: End users considering selling real estate or using land
entries.af4453218a1f5585: Provides matching services such as 『Livin Match』, which connects people considering selling or using real estate with real estate companies, and cloud services for housing-related companies.
entries.c84b5cfccce6b3b9: This is a single segment of the group, consisting of the company and one consolidated subsidiary, and is made up of two parts: a matching platform centered on the housing-sector vertical media 'Livin Match,' and a DX cloud that supports operational efficiency at housing-related companies.
entries.daf9673d32b9e3de: Client companies such as real estate companies
entries.f1bc1a99e7fcbf0a: This business provides, via the cloud, Web services (SaaS) and the like that promote operational efficiency at housing-related companies. It offers E-learning, call centers (BPO), AI appraisal, SMS delivery, SFA and more, and usage fees are in principle monthly fees. Revenue for the fiscal year ended September 2025 was ¥429 million.
